If we just wanted to write a formula for the volume, without carrying out any of the integrations, we could write

The expression on the right, called an iterated or repeated integral, says that the volume is obtained by integrating 4 - x - y with respect to y from y = 0 to y = 1, holding x fixed, and then integrating the resulting expression in x with respect to x from x = 0 to

x = 2. The limits of integration 0 and 1 are associated with y, so they are placed on the integral closest to dy. The other limits of integration, 0 and 2, are associated with the vari- able x, so they are placed on the outside integral symbol that is paired with dx.
